title: Hair Restoration
intro: Is your hair thinning? Are you worried about hair loss? Hair loss can happen at any age, but NEA Precision Skin can help. We have two difference options to help you get your luxurious locks back.

body.text: Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP) has been around for several decades and has been widely used in skin and wound healing. PRP is your own blood plasma that is enriched with platelets, making it a natural and organic option, specific to you. Our blood is made of two main components, red blood cells, and plasma. The plasma contains white blood cells and platelets, which are rich in growth factors. PRP contains several different and powerful growth factors that stimulate the healing of bone and soft tissue, as well as hair growth! Growth factors can help stimulate the activity of the hair follicles and promote new hair growth. When we inject PRP into the scalp it actually stimulates the stem cells in the hair root that turns on the hair follicle again. In addition, PRP contains six growth factors, so it stimulates blood flow to the hair follicles encouraging the hair to grow normally again. The procedure involves placing blood drawn from the client into a special machine that separates red blood cells from the plasma which is rich in platelets and contains the growth factors. The Platelet rich plasma is reinjected into the scalp to stimulate growth. Many evidence-based articles and research has shown that PRP is beneficial in increasing the hair count, hair thickness, and the growth phase of the hair cycle. The use of PRP is a great treatment option for hair thinning. When people lose hair, the follicles don’t just go away they just become dormant, and PRP can help stimulate them. Success is reported, in repeated treatments.

Fotona’s Smooth Mode using the ER:YAG is used for hair restoration as it stimulates dormant hair follicles with control and gentle bulk heating. This also increase the blood flow to the scalp resulting in productions of hair growth. It is a 15-20 minute procedure with minimal discomfort and no need for numbing. For optimal results, recommended treatment is to combine platelet rich plasma (PRP) treatment 2 weeks apart.

title: Active Acne
intro: Acne is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become clogged with oil and dead skin cells. It often leads to pimples, blackheads, whiteheads, and sometimes more severe lesions like cysts or nodules.

Acne and acne scars can significantly impact a person’s self-esteem and quality of life. However, there are numerous treatments available to manage acne and reduce the appearance of scars. Consulting with a skincare professional is essential to develop a personalized treatment plan based on the individual’s skin type and the severity of their condition.
Causes of Acne:
list: Excess oil production: Sebaceous glands produce too much sebum.
Clogged hair follicles: Dead skin cells and oil can clog hair follicles.
Bacteria: Propionibacterium acnes (P. acnes) can contribute to inflammation.
Hormonal changes: Androgens can increase sebum production, especially during puberty.
Diet and lifestyle: Some foods and stress may exacerbate acne.

title: Acne Scarring
intro: Acne scars occur when the skin heals after an acne lesion has been inflamed. Scars form when the skin produces too much or too little collagen during the healing process. Types of acne scars include:
list: Atrophic scars: Depressed scars caused by a loss of tissue. These include:Ice pick scars: Deep, narrow scars.Boxcar scars: Broad, rectangular scars with steep edges. Rolling scars: Wide, shallow scars with a rolling appearance.Hypertrophic and keloid scars: Raised scars that occur when the skin produces too much collagen.

title: Rosacea
intro: Rosacea is a common skin disease, that can affect both men and women. It often begins around age 30, with a tendency to blush or flush more easily than other people. The main characteristics of rosacea can be described as persistent erythema (redness), facial flushing, pink skin, telangiectasia (visible broken capillaries), and inflammatory papules (bumps) and pustules (blemishes). Left untreated, rosacea can continue to evolve with more pronounced spider veins/Telangiectasia and possible acne lesions. There is no medical cure for Rosacea, however laser treatments can help reduce or control the unwanted symptoms, combined with lifestyle and diet to further keep it under control.

The exclusive delivery modes are used in concert for hyperthermic adipocyte destruction and collagen remodeling with exceptional results.

Results

will vary with every individual. Most patients will see immediate tightening followed by a gradual change in contour as your fat breaks down. Depending on your desired results, you may require multiple treatments.

title: Laser Hair Removal
intro: At NEA Precision Skin, our high-performance laser systems with FRAC3 technology have introduced new standards of efficiency in providing safe and effective hair reduction – using an

innovative system that effectively targets hair follicles with a combination of selective and homogenous photothermolysis. Your Desired Choice. We offer a safe and effective laser hair removal treatments for both men and women. Because laser hair removal is a more permanent solution for hair removal than shaving and waxing it’s quickly become the desired choice for those who want to eliminate hair and enjoy the added side effects of smoother skin without ingrown hairs

more.text: Laser Hair RemovalOur lasers incorporate revolutionary pulse-control technology and a proprietary three-dimensional treatment pattern (FRAC3®) to provide safe and effective hair reduction. Unlike other wavelengths, it is safe to use on all skin types. The innovative system effectively targets surface treatment areas while leaving surrounding tissues unaffected.

The success of hair reduction treatments depends largely on a patient’s skin and hair type, as well as the skills and treatment insight of the practitioner. Most patients can expect a significant reduction in unwanted hair, and any future hair growth will usually be thinner and lighter, and thus much less pronounced than before.

title: Wart Removal
intro: Fotona offers treatment for a wide range of warts and verrucae using both the ND:Yag and ER lasers. This treatment provides extremely precise ablation of warts paired with deep and selective absorption of the ND:Yag causing the coagulation of blood vessels, feeding the wart causing death of infected cells. Antibacterial effects from the treatment promote faster healing and reduce the possibility of reoccurrence.
There is no anaesthesia or extra tissue removal. And no special post procedure is necessary. Making this a very easy and effective way of removing warts.

title: Snoring and Sleep Apnea
intro: At NEA Precision Skin, our snoring and apnea therapy is the patient-friendly Fotona’s NightLase® therapy laser treatment. This is a non-invasive, patient-friendly laser treatment for increasing the quality of a patient’s sleep. Medical procedures for sleep apnea include tonsillectomy and/or adenoidectomy, which involves the removal of the tonsils and adenoids structures. Surgical intervention may not always be an option for some people, however, with laser technology NEA Precision Skin can help treat your snoring related issues and enhance daily lives, in a non-invasive manner. Our treatment can reduce the effects of and decrease the amplitude of snoring by means of a gentle laser treatment of the oral mucosa tissue.

body.text: Snoring is directly related to other unwanted conditions like obstructive sleep apnea. Sleep apnea patients can have symptoms like low energy, hypertension, and increased risk of stroke and heart attack.A full course consists of three separate treatment sessions over a two month period. The final results of the treatment have been shown to last up to a year, and the therapy can be repeated.Patients find the procedure to be a highly comfortable and satisfying solution.
Benefits
Simple and Effective• Non – Invasive solution• No need to wear devices during sleep• Clinically proven to eliminate or reduce snoring• Fast, comfortable, walk-in, walk-out procedure
How does NightLase work

Fotona’s patented Er: YAG laser allows a safe penetration of heat into the oral mucosa tissue. It is gentle enough to be used on the sensitive tissue inside the mouth but strong enough to provide clinically efficacious heating. Research has shown that NightLase reduces and attenuates snoring and provides an effective, non-invasive way to lessen the effects of sleep apnea.A full course of NightLase consists of three separate treatment sessions over a six week period. The final results of the treatment have been shown to last up to a year, and the therapy can be repeated. NightLase is a highly comfortable and satisfying solution. NightLase requires no device to be worn.

title: Feminine Health
intro: Feminine wellbeing and quality of life can be affected by childbirth and the natural aging process. Symptoms such as incontinence, dryness, Itchiness, and vaginal relaxation can often occur. These can be embarrassing and uncomfortable. It affects more women than you think.
list: 40% of women suffer from some form of urinary incontinence
80% of women will experience vaginal atrophy

body.text: This treatment is indicated to treat vaginal relaxation syndrome, which is also referred to as a lax or loose vaginal canal. This causes vaginal tissue to lose elasticity and tone that can cause a decrease in sexual satisfaction for both parties.
How it Works

Our experienced medical technicians use non-invasive photo-thermal laser treatment IntimaLase™ to tighten the walls of the vaginal tissues and cure vaginal atrophy and VRS. Laser therapy is a safer and less invasive alternative for vaginal tightening than surgery. Patient satisfaction rate is up to 95% with immediate reported improvement.An attachment similar to a speculum used during PAP tests is inserted into the vagina to send short laser pulses.One to three painless sessions is recommended for optimal results, and procedures take place in the comfort of NEA Precision Skin. Continual results can be seen for weeks and months post treatments as new collagen is being created. The entire procedure takes about 15 minutes. There are no pre or post preparations required, and patients report almost no discomfort.

Stress Urinary Incontinence (SUI) is common among women and causes the involuntary loss of urine while coughing, sneezing, laughing or exerting physical effort primarily due to vaginal child birth, obesity and aging.NEA Precision Skin offers safe and effective laser therapy to tighten the connective tissues supporting the bladder and eliminate mild to moderate cases of urinary stress and mixed incontinence. Unlike surgical treatments, laser therapy allows you to resume your normal activities immediately post the procedure.
How it Works

The Incontilase Laser Treatment is delivered through the vagina with pulses causing the collagen and vaginal mucosa tissues to shrink, tighten and naturally repair bladder support. 94% of patients reported significant improvements in SUI after 120 days and 68% were completely free of SUI*.

title: Fungal Nail Infection/Fungus
intro: At NEA Precision Skin, our ClearSteps™ Onychomycosis Treatment is a revolutionary, patient-friendly method for treating onychomycosis (toenail fungus). It is a simple and effective procedure that uses the power of ND: YAG laser light to heat evenly throughout the depth of the affected nail and skin tissue, effectively weakening and killing parasitic fungi which have infected the patient’s nails.

body.text: The most common cause of onychomycosis is dermatophyte fungus that invades the dead tissue of skin or nails. Other causes include contact with certain moulds or species of yeasts. The overall prevalence of onychomycosis ranges from 2 to 14 percent of the population. Onychomycosis is caused by contact with infective fungal agents. Since these agents are present everywhere in our environment, everyone potentially is at risk for infection. Common sources for infection could include public showers, swimming pools, nail spas and gyms. Nail trauma and tight fitting shoes can also lead to infection.
Three Simple Steps
Step 1File down the Nail. During onychomycosis the nail will become deformed and overgrown, it may also thicken. Filing down the nail allows laser light to fully penetrate into the treatment site.
Step 2

Administer Nd:YAG laser pulses in a circular pattern covering the entire nail. Slightly overlap the beam so that the nail is fully covered. The patient should feel a slight heating sensation throughout the nail.
Step 3

Target Nd:YAG laser pulses around the perimeter of the nail bed and around the finger or toe. Often parasitic fungus has worked its way beyond the nail bed and needs to be eliminated in all the tissue surrounding the nail to prevent recurrence.The treatment involves passing a laser beam over the infected nail and surrounding tissue, resulting in a photo-thermal heating effect that weakens and kills the fungi that cause the infection. A single treatment usually takes about 45 minutes to treat 10 nails. You may feel a heating sensation during the treatment, however you can leave immediately after the procedure and resume your daily routine. You could also experience some slight discolouration of the nail after the treatment.
Results

Improvement may be seen after a single session, however best results are typically achieved through a series of 3-4 treatments. Successful treatment will result in the growth of a new, healthy nail. However it could take up to 1 year to see an entirely clear nail, depending on the rate of growth.
